results.description:
Second chances.
Soulmates.
And a small town you'll never forget.

Ten years ago, Blake Carter and Emmy Doyle were college sweethearts, madly in love with the world at their feet. Nothing could tear them apart...until a campus tragedy changed Drake Isle forever.

Now Blake's a ruthless billionaire, looking to expand his business and prove himself to his doubting, domineering father. The only thing stopping his island takeover? The woman he's never gotten over, who now owns a yoga studio in the oceanfront building he wants to buy.

They haven't spoken in a decade. They're on opposite sides of a million-dollar deal. But old flames die hard, and sometimes soulmates can set the world on fire all over again.

Is it possible to trust in love the second time around? Or will Blake and Emmy go down fighting and leave Drake Isle in ashes?
